name: November
objective: Long commitments in the softest month without discounting 1 Month; a no-purchase member appreciation week that generates guest leads.
strategy:
Black Friday + Thank U, Next.

Commercial job: Long commitments in the softest month without discounting 1 Month; a no-purchase member appreciation week that generates guest leads.

Renewal: Black Friday, Strong Monday, Sore Tuesday (“Black Friday, Strong Monday, sore Tuesday.”). November is the trough (Kwality ₹18.5L, Bandra ₹13.2L in Nov-25). Long-plan pricing brings cash forward without discounting 1 Month.

Goodwill: Thank U, Next (Year) (“Thank u, next (year).”). Each guest pass is a referral-quality lead (referrals convert 22–76%). Goodwill before December renewals lifts renewal yield.
notes: Build: 46 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹5.1L; 50 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹11.8L; 22 winbacks = ₹2.6L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹1.9L. Offers carry ₹13.4L (63% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 51% CRM status, trial→member 26.9%) — not invented lifts.

funnel.dataQuality: lead→trial = CRM 'Trial Completed' status (not attendance-verified); trial→member = trailing measured; see dataGaps

Mid-month review against ₹21.4L: by the 15th aim for ~half of 46 new buyers (171 first visits), 50 renewals and 22 winbacks. Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
Close November: tag every redemption by offer ID (O27-xx), log trial attendance and trial→purchase per offer, brief next month.
